what_differs: Jira builds Signup Currency as a formula from the Player's country/CurrencyIsoCode. The 8/27 client session decided the sign-up payout currency defaults from the Deal's market country (Canada=CAD, US=USD), is stamped on the Sign-Up (not a player formula, because of relocation cases) and stays editable by Ops. No ticket implements the Deal-market-country default.
suggested_action: Confirm with Emily which rule is current (8/27 deal-market-country stamp vs the 9/18 Slack-agreed player-country formula). If 8/27 stands, add a story for the Deal-market-country default on Sign-Up and update WAGR-404/WAGR-160. Note WAGR-415: most SLCs arrive without player country, so a player-country rule falls back to CAD.
